card.title: PZL.23 KARAS
card.text: At the end of your turn, add a SECTION II to your hand.
card.flavorText: The PZL.23 Karas was an all-metal Polish light bomber and reconnaissance aircraft that was developed in the 1930s and used during the defense of Poland in 1939. A total of 250 PZL.23’s were built from 1936 to 1939, but only 110 were combat ready when war struck. The primary role of the PZL.23’s was to fly reconnaissance missions, but some were used in successful bombing missions, both against industrial targets in Germany and against the advancing German armies. The PZL.23’s suffered heavy casualties during the defense of Poland, both because of the lack of fighter support and due to its light armor and low speed. There are no known PZL.23s survivors of the war.
